name: Hazukashigariya no Rumi-chan wa Itazura Sarete Kimochi Yoku Nacchau no
original_name: 恥ずかしがり屋のるみちゃんは悪戯されて気持ち良くなっちゃうの
source:
A shy girl with no friends is toyed by a horny mischief-maker. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE145648.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个没有朋友的害羞女孩，被好色的恶作剧者玩弄。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE145648.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
